blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A co-accused of former Speaker Martin Romualdez in his P7.44-billion plunder case has been allowed by the Sandiganbayan Third Division to testify as a prosecution witness during the bail hearing of the detained lawmaker. In a resolution made public on Friday, the court granted the prosecution’s motion to exclude Samchan Foreign Exchange Corp. president Felicito Guevarra from the list of accused in the case to enable him to testify as a state witness. Romualdez is currently facing a plunder charge over allegations that he received P7.44 billion in kickbacks from government infrastructure projects funded under the national budgets […]...
